QUOTE: "Any other value, including the setting being absent, turns it on. When the server doesn't send it, the app behaves as if the feature is enabled." and "`const archivedChannelsViewable = (value?: string) => value !== 'false';`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that an absent setting means archived channels are viewable and only explicit 'false' disables them.
